evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce WarBias, a Ukrainian-English benchmark of stereotypes about these two groups.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Built from a taxonomy of 120 stereotype claims grounded in research and monitoring reports, WarBias contains 1,007 stereotype-counter-stereotype-unrelated sentence triplets and 240 multiple-choice questions per language.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: In a baseline evaluation of six models, four prefer stereotypical Ukrainian sentences about at least one group, most strongly about IDPs, while English scores are mostly balanced.
